edits.new:
a new build takes new runs while the old build drains. The build ID format and the versioning policy are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0659; ASM-1130).

**Run policy.** `BookingMatchWorkflow` runs on `rwb-integration` at Asia/Bangkok, with one run per business date: a second start is refused with MSG-P2-006, and a failed gate is retried on the next `AceDataReady` for the same date. No fallback Schedule is created. With the flag `rwb.integration.booking-confirmation` off, the booking work stops at the start, the run ends SKIPPED with no write, and the records already written stay readable. The names of the properties that carry these settings are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2491).
